serviceName: Proposal links on your own domain
description: Points a subdomain such as proposals.example.com to wearebid so that proposal links open on the customer's own address, and publishes the ownership token wearebid issued for that hostname.
variableDescription: token: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters that wearebid issues per claimed hostname. wearebid serves the hostname only while the TXT record at _wearebid.<host> carries this exact value.
